title: NFT-KYC Hub Configuration
description: Configuration file schema for NFT-KYC Hub. Environment variables take precedence over values in this file.

NODE_ENV.description: Runtime environment. In production, all secrets must be explicitly set.

KYC_MASTER_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM master key as 64 hex characters (32 bytes). Required in production.

KYC_MASTER_KEY_ID.description: Key identifier for the active master key

KYC_PAST_KEYS.description: Comma-separated rotation keys in format 'keyId:64hexchars'. Empty string means no rotation keys.

CREDENTIAL_HASH_SALT.description: Salt for credential digests (anchored on-chain). Minimum 16 characters. Required in production.

PARTNER_API_KEYS.description: Comma-separated 'apiKey:marketplaceId' pairs. API keys are hashed (SHA-256) at startup. At least one required in production.

REPORT_SIGNING_KEY.description: Secret for signing compliance reports (HMAC-SHA256 today, ECDSA P-256 for PDF). Minimum 16 characters. Required in production.

EID_EIDAS_SECRET.description: Shared secret for eIDAS Gateway assertion validation. Minimum 8 characters. Required in production.

EID_FRANCE_CONNECT_SECRET.description: Shared secret for FranceConnect assertion validation. Minimum 8 characters. Required in production.

EID_EIDAS_JWKS_URI.description: JWKS endpoint URI for eIDAS Gateway (real PKI validation)

EID_EIDAS_ISSUER.description: Expected issuer for eIDAS Gateway JWT assertions

EID_EIDAS_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for eIDAS Gateway JWT assertions

EID_FRANCE_CONNECT_JWKS_URI.description: JWKS endpoint URI for FranceConnect (real PKI validation)

EID_FRANCE_CONNECT_ISSUER.description: Expected issuer for FranceConnect JWT assertions

EID_FRANCE_CONNECT_AUDIENCE.description: Expected audience for FranceConnect JWT assertions

SANCTIONS_LIST_URL.description: URL to fetch live sanctions list feed (JSON format)

SANCTIONS_FEED_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Request timeout for sanctions feed fetch in milliseconds (default: 10000, max: 60000)

SANCTIONS_FEED_MAX_SIZE_BYTES.description: Maximum response body size for sanctions feed in bytes (default: 5242880 = 5 MB, max: 52428800 = 50 MB)

ENABLED_EID_PROVIDERS.description: Comma-separated list of enabled e-ID providers. Must be explicitly set in production. Known values: 'eidas-gateway', 'franceconnect'.

KYC_CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to this config file (self-referential, only used by the process environment, not read from the file itself)

KYC_DYNAMODB_TABLE.description: DynamoDB table name for the KYC repository (production). Required in production.

KYC_DYNAMODB_REGION.description: DynamoDB region (defaults to AWS default region chain)

KYC_DYNAMODB_ENDPOINT.description: DynamoDB endpoint override (for local testing with DynamoDB Local)

KYC_POLYGON_RPC_URL.description: Polygon zk-EVM RPC endpoint URL (e.g., https://zkevm-rpc.com). Required for Polygon anchoring in production.

KYC_POLYGON_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Private key for the Polygon anchoring wallet as 64 hex characters (32 bytes). Required for Polygon anchoring in production.

KYC_POLYGON_CONTRACT_ADDRESS.description: Address of the deployed anchor registry contract on Polygon zk-EVM. Required for Polygon anchoring in production.

KYC_POLYGON_CHAIN_ID.description: Polygon zk-EVM chain ID (1101 for mainnet, 1442 for testnet).
